name: Calendar
description: Single-date calendar grid and popover date picker for form dates and lightweight filters.

Calendar.description: Inline month grid for selecting one calendar day.

defaultValue.description: Initial selected date for uncontrolled usage.

onValueChange.description: Called when a selectable day is picked.

onMonthChange.description: Called when previous or next month navigation changes the visible month.

locale.description: BCP 47 locale used for month and aria labels.

startOfWeek.description: First day of the week, where 0 is Sunday and 1 is Monday.

showOutsideDays.description: Show days from adjacent months in the fixed six-week grid.

className.description: Additional classes for the calendar root.

DatePicker.description: Popover trigger plus Calendar for selecting one date from a form field.

defaultValue.description: Initial selected date for uncontrolled usage.

onValueChange.description: Called when a date is picked. The popover closes after selection.

name.description: Optional hidden input name. Submitted value is yyyy-mm-dd.

placeholder.description: Trigger text before a date is selected.

disabled.description: Disable the trigger and block opening.

locale.description: Locale used for display labels and calendar aria labels.

startOfWeek.description: First day of the week passed to Calendar.

triggerClassName.description: Additional classes for the date picker trigger.

calendarClassName.description: Additional classes for the popup Calendar.

className.description: Additional classes for the DatePicker wrapper.

forbidden: Do not use Calendar as an event planner or scheduler grid.
Do not use DatePicker for long relative ranges when preset chips plus two date inputs are clearer.
Do not store raw Date objects directly in APIs; convert at the app boundary.
Do not hide required labels inside placeholder text.

responsive.note: Day buttons, month navigation, and the DatePicker trigger are all 44px. On narrow mobile layouts, put DatePicker in a full-width Field and avoid multi-month popups.
